title: Checking Data Types
description: Learn how to use the type() function to check the data type of any variable.
code:
age = 20
print("age type:", type(age))

price = 99.50
print("price type:", type(price))

is_student = True
print("is_student type:", type(is_student))

name = "Arun"
print("name type:", type(name))

title: Dynamic Typing
description: Watch how a variable can change its data type dynamically in Python.
code:
data = 10
print(data)
print(type(data))

# Now we assign a string to the exact same variable
data = "Python"
print(data)
print(type(data))

# Now it becomes a float
data = 25.5
print(data)
print(type(data))

title: Student Details Output
description: A mini real-time program putting it all together.
code:
student_name = "Arun"
student_age = 20
student_mark = 87.5
is_present = True

print("----- Student Details -----")
print("Name:", student_name)
print("Age:", student_age)
print("Mark:", student_mark)
print("Present:", is_present)

print("\n----- Data Types -----")
print(type(student_name))
print(type(student_age))
print(type(student_mark))
print(type(is_present))
